mathematical_findings.parent_all: ALL(SC-K-BOX-NE-FPT-TYPES, SC-K-GREEDY-BOX-EXISTS) implies SC-K-FROZEN-LIGHT-FPT. Type ILP alone does not guarantee feasibility; existence alone does not give FPT time.
mathematical_findings.exact_support: Types use exact weight plus full occupied menu. y<=x<=n*y activates every original comparison q_t*(W_s-w_i)<=q_s*W_t exactly when that type is present at s; subtract one atomic self weight. Nonactive rows use the component total-weight bound. Box inequalities never delete original actions.
mathematical_findings.feasibility: The proved greedy box theorem preserves exactly the same heavy/single-option frozen set. Restrict its witness to each movable-light component; every local IP is feasible without running the potentially exponential finite improvement process.
mathematical_findings.frozen_cross_component_actions: For every frozen heavy customer and every original destination t, including another light component: (W_s-w_i)/q_s <= ((q_s+1)*gamma-gamma)/q_s = gamma <= W_t/q_t. Frozen single-option customers have no other occupied station. Movable customers retain their full menu in one component; uncovered customers have no actions.
mathematical_findings.complexity: At most 2*d*(c*2^(c-1)-c) integer variables per light component; explicit binary rational coefficients, denominator clearing and named-label recovery have polynomial bit/output cost. Standard fixed-variable ILP yields f(c,d)*poly(L).
mathematical_findings.three_site_slice: Nonempty HM and ML movable menus form one 3-site component. Set c=3, obtaining the valid general upper bound 18*d integer variables and f(3,d)*poly(L). d counts exact distinct movable light weights in that component, not clients or frozen/global weights. Every fixed d-bound covers all valid chain inputs, including mixed weights on the same edge.
mathematical_findings.whole_vs_contribution: The repaired parent edge proves the whole on-path FPT target. The 3B edge proves only a parameterized contribution to the open chain target. Neither edge claims full off-path/default continuation output.
mathematical_findings.unbounded_d_gap: The target requires one uniform algorithm and one fixed polynomial P independent of input and d. The parameter function f(3,d) cannot be omitted when d grows with the input; finite whole-pool descent does not bound repeated returns or total phases.
mathematical_findings.continuation: Given the same greedy original pools/q/gamma and output box NE, independent BOX-TO-2 plus proved MAX completes every actual labelled deviation and default pure NE query. Surviving sources use current pools; disappearing singleton sources reset the entire original pools. That completion is not a missing premise of this on-path chain target.
mathematical_findings.xp_boundary: SC-K-CATALOG-WEIGHT-XP-2 remains formally conditional in the current registry; this review makes no metadata change. The standard ILP and known MAX import can be explained without mechanically upgrading its truth_status. Its (k+1)^(p-1)*p!*p*f(p,d)*poly(L) bound remains XP, not FPT.
mathematical_findings.hardness_boundary: The arbitrary-occupancy 3-PARTITION reduction has no genuine greedy promise. For m>=2, after the first site captures all public items and private gamma, its next score (m+1)*gamma/2 exceeds every unopened site score gamma, ruling out the all-q=1 reduction occupancy as that greedy output.
